title: Hidden collision statistics in bosonic heat transport: Superthermal correlations at fixed mean current
summary: Reservoirs with the same mean relaxation rate can be indistinguishable at the level of average energy transport while producing different fluctuations. We study a bosonic mode coupled to hot and cold Poisson streams of thermal ancillas through finite beam-splitter collisions. The averaged evolution is a compound-Poisson semigroup generated by finite Gaussian event channels. Its nonequilibrium steady state is an exact mixture of thermal states governed by a random affine fixed point.
